scope_note: Adapted revision items from publisher collection positions 26–40. These positions are webpage order, not authenticated UTME question numbers. Answers and explanations were independently recalculated.

items.question: Let P={2,3,5,7} and Q={1,3,5,7,9}. Which set contains the elements that belong to exactly one of P and Q?
items.explanation: The elements only in P form {2}; the elements only in Q form {1,9}. Their union is {1,2,9}.

items.question: Write the binary number 10111.11₂ as a mixed number in base ten.
items.explanation: The whole-number part is 16+4+2+1=23. The fractional part is 1/2+1/4=3/4, so the result is 23¾.

items.question: Calculate 20045₇ − 14256₇ and give the result in base seven.
items.explanation: Convert to base ten: 20045₇=4835 and 14256₇=3912. The difference is 923, which is 2456₇.

items.question: Four teachers have an average age of 40 years, and eight other teachers average 25 years. What is the average age of all twelve teachers?
items.explanation: The total age is 4×40+8×25=360 years. Divide by all 12 teachers to get an average of 30 years.

items.question: How many subsets, including the empty set and the set itself, does a set of five distinct elements have?
items.explanation: Each of five elements can either be included or excluded, giving 2⁵=32 possible subsets.

items.question: The mean of 13, 16, x, 18, 21, 2x and 35 is 22. Find x.
items.explanation: The seven values must total 7×22=154. Their known values total 103, so 103+3x=154 and x=17.

items.question: A data set has a standard deviation of 12.34. What is its variance to the nearest whole number?
items.explanation: Variance is the square of the standard deviation: 12.34²=152.2756, which rounds to 152.

items.question: Find the population standard deviation of the values 5, 4, 6, 7 and 8.
items.explanation: The mean is 6. The squared deviations sum to 1+4+0+1+4=10; dividing by five gives variance 2 and standard deviation √2.

items.question: A class has five girls and seven boys. In how many ways can a committee of two girls and three boys be chosen?
items.explanation: Choose the girls in C(5,2)=10 ways and the boys in C(7,3)=35 ways. Multiply to get 350 committees.

items.question: A bag has seven red and four black balls. Two independent draws are made with replacement. What is the probability of drawing the same colour twice?
items.explanation: Both red has probability (7/11)² and both black (4/11)². Add them to get 49/121+16/121=65/121.

items.question: U varies directly with √V. If U=24 when V=9, what is V when U=16?
items.explanation: Write U=k√V. The first pair gives k=24/3=8. Then 16=8√V, so √V=2 and V=4.

items.question: B varies inversely with the cube root of C. If B=2 when C=27, find the constant of proportionality.
items.explanation: Use B=k/∛C. Since ∛27=3 and B=2, multiply both sides of 2=k/3 by 3 to obtain k=6.
